brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu cut short his visit to the United States and flew back to Israel immediately following his address, according to Israeli public broadcaster Kan. The Middle East Eye reported the abrupt departure, which came directly after his speech.

No details were provided regarding Netanyahu's reasons for the early exit or the content of his remarks during the visit.
dek: Netanyahu cuts his US trip short, departs for Israel Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has left the US for Israel directly after his speech, Israeli public broadcaster Kan reported.
title: Netanyahu departs US early, returns to Israel after speech
